# support (support.origincloudapis.eu)

Guide: <https://docs.origincloud.eu/docs/platform/support-cases/index.html.md>

- **CaseService**: Support cases: an organization's questions and problems, and where each one stands.
- **CaseMessageService**: A case's messages: its conversation between the organization and support, oldest first.

## Packages

| Language | Install | Import |
|---|---|---|
| Rust | `cargo add origincloud-support@0.25.0` | `origincloud_support::v1beta1` |
| Go | `go get go.origincloud.eu/sdk@v0.27.0` | `go.origincloud.eu/sdk/support/v1beta1` (package `supportv1beta1`) |
| TypeScript | `npm install @origincloud/core@0.26.0 @origincloud/support@0.26.0` | `@origincloud/support/v1beta1` |

## CaseService

Support cases: an organization's questions and problems, and where each one stands.

| Language | Client |
|---|---|
| Rust | `CaseClient::new(&client)` |
| Go | `supportv1beta1.NewCaseClient(client)` |
| TypeScript | `new CaseClient(client)` |

| RPC | Rust | Go | TypeScript | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GetCase` (`GetCaseRequest`) | `get_case` | `GetCase` | `getCase` | Returns a case. requires `name` |
| `ListCases` (`ListCasesRequest`) | `list_cases`, `all_cases` | `ListCases`, `AllCases` | `listCases`, `allCases` | Lists an organization's cases, newest first. requires `parent` |
| `CreateCase` (`CreateCaseRequest`) | `create_case` | `CreateCase` | `createCase` | Opens a case, `OPEN`. a retry with the same `request_id` is safe; requires `parent`, `case` |
| `CloseCase` (`CloseCaseRequest`) | `close_case` | `CloseCase` | `closeCase` | Closes a case: its `state` becomes `CLOSED`, and its contact email is notified. requires `name` |
| `ReopenCase` (`ReopenCaseRequest`) | `reopen_case` | `ReopenCase` | `reopenCase` | Opens a resolved or closed case again: its `state` becomes `OPEN`, and its contact email is notified. requires `name` |

## CaseMessageService

A case's messages: its conversation between the organization and support, oldest first.

| Language | Client |
|---|---|
| Rust | `CaseMessageClient::new(&client)` |
| Go | `supportv1beta1.NewCaseMessageClient(client)` |
| TypeScript | `new CaseMessageClient(client)` |

| RPC | Rust | Go | TypeScript | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GetCaseMessage` (`GetCaseMessageRequest`) | `get_case_message` | `GetCaseMessage` | `getCaseMessage` | Returns one message of a case. requires `name` |
| `ListCaseMessages` (`ListCaseMessagesRequest`) | `list_case_messages`, `all_case_messages` | `ListCaseMessages`, `AllCaseMessages` | `listCaseMessages`, `allCaseMessages` | Lists a case's messages, oldest first. requires `parent` |
| `CreateCaseMessage` (`CreateCaseMessageRequest`) | `create_case_message` | `CreateCaseMessage` | `createCaseMessage` | Adds a message to a case's conversation. a retry with the same `request_id` is safe; requires `parent`, `case_message` |

Field names: Rust uses the proto names (`size_gib`), Go protoc-gen-go's (`SizeGib`), TypeScript the JSON names (`sizeGib`).

## Resources

### Case

A support case: one question or problem, and the conversation about it.

- Full name: `//support.origincloudapis.eu/organizations/{organization}/cases/{case}`
- `name`: `organizations/{organization}/cases/{case}`

| Field (JSON) | Type | Behavior | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | identifier | The case's resource name, `organizations/{organization}/cases/{case}`. |
| `urn` | string | output only | The case's URN, the identifier access policies and the audit log use. |
| `project` | string | optional, immutable | The project the case is about, `projects/{project}`, one of the organization's. Names a `Project`. |
| `subject` | string | required, immutable | A one-line summary. |
| `description` | string | required, immutable | What the case is about, in full. |
| `contactEmail` | string | required, immutable | The email address every notification about the case is sent to, for as long as the case exists: when support replies, and when its state changes. |
| `state` | Case.State | output only | Where the case stands. One of `OPEN`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `RESOLVED`, `CLOSED`. |
| `creator` | string | output only | The principal that opened the case, such as `user:<id>` or `service_account:<id>`. |
| `createTime` | timestamp | output only | When the case was opened. |
| `updateTime` | timestamp | output only | When the case last changed: a message added, or its state changed. |

### CaseMessage

One message of a case's conversation.

- Full name: `//support.origincloudapis.eu/organizations/{organization}/cases/{case}/messages/{message}`
- `name`: `organizations/{organization}/cases/{case}/messages/{message}`

| Field (JSON) | Type | Behavior | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | identifier | The message's resource name, `organizations/{organization}/cases/{case}/messages/{message}`. |
| `body` | string | required, immutable | The message's text. |
| `author` | string | output only | The principal that wrote the message, such as `user:<id>` or `service_account:<id>`. |
| `createTime` | timestamp | output only | When the message was added. |
